meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或一段文案变成一支产品发布宣传片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上只有产品链接或一段文案,却要快速做出一支能直接投放的发布短片。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or a short brief into a launch promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if all you have is a product link or a brief but need a ready-to-post launch video.

howto.what: 把产品/营销网址、粘贴的脚本或简介，做成产品发布或宣传视频：抓取网页、选设计预设、写分镜与脚本、逐帧生成并渲染出 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你想宣传、发布、推广或揭晓某个产品时触发；商业网址默认走这条流程，网站导览/展示也归它。意图不明时先读 /hyperframes。
